title: A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub
script:
Samsung is building a massive new semiconductor manufacturing complex in Pyeongtaek, South Korea.
Generative AI models run on powerful chips known as graphics processing units.
These processors depend on stacks of specialized memory chips packaged directly with them.
Three fabrication plants already operate around the clock at the site.
A fourth facility is now coming online to meet growing demand for memory.
Will this massive new complex keep up with global hardware needs?
